cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a futuristic orbital hydroponic fruit orchard — she rests after carrying a basket of spare fruit for the crew; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — standing; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a modern planetarium outreach corner after a show — she playfully demonstrates a star-map fold for visitors off camera; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a wooden sauna and cold plunge with a cooling lounge — holds a towel folded against her chest; her bedroom — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — lying on her front; a night observatory under an open dome — standing; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — writes with a calligraphy brush and an ink stone on rice paper laid flat on the table; a candlelit gala dinner hall — standing
